pli-tv-bu-vb-np26:1.1: tena samayena buddho bhagavā rājagahe viharati veḷuvane kalandakanivāpe.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np26:1.2: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū cīvarakārasamaye bahuṃ suttaṃ viññāpesuṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np26:1.3: katepi cīvare bahu suttaṃ avasiṭṭhaṃ hoti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np26:1.5: handa mayaṃ āvuso aññaṃpi suttaṃ viññāpetvā tantavāyehi cīvaraṃ vāyāpemāti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np26:1.6: athakho chabbaggiyā bhikkhū aññaṃpi suttaṃ viññāpetvā tantavāyehi cīvaraṃ vāyāpesuṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np26:1.7: vītepi cīvare bahu suttaṃ avasiṭṭhaṃ hoti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np26:1.8: dutiyampi kho chabbaggiyā bhikkhū aññaṃpi suttaṃ viññāpetvā tantavāyehi cīvaraṃ vāyāpesuṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np26:1.9: vītepi cīvare bahu suttaṃ avasiṭṭhaṃ hoti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np26:1.10: tatiyampi kho chabbaggiyā bhikkhū aññaṃpi suttaṃ viññāpetvā tantavāyehi cīvaraṃ vāyāpesuṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np26:1.12: kathaṃ hi nāma samaṇā sakyaputtiyā sāmaṃ suttaṃ viññāpetvā tantavāyehi cīvaraṃ vāyāpessantīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np26:1.13: assosuṃ kho bhikkhū tesaṃ manussānaṃ ujjhāyantānaṃ khīyantānaṃ vipācentānaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np26:1.14: ye te bhikkhū appicchā …pe… te ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti
pli-tv-bu-vb-np26:1.15: kathaṃ hi nāma chabbaggiyā bhikkhū sāmaṃ suttaṃ viññāpetvā tantavāyehi cīvaraṃ vāyāpessantīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np26:1.16: athakho te bhikkhū bhagavato etamatthaṃ ārocesuṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np26:1.17: saccaṃ kira tumhe bhikkhave sāmaṃ suttaṃ viññāpetvā tantavāyehi cīvaraṃ vāyāpethāti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np26:1.20: hi nāma tumhe moghapurisā sāmaṃ suttaṃ viññāpetvā tantavāyehi cīvaraṃ vāyāpessatha
pli-tv-bu-vb-np26:1.21: netaṃ moghapurisā appasannānaṃ vā pasādāya pasannānaṃ vā bhiyyobhāvāya …pe…
pli-tv-bu-vb-np26:1.22: evañca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha
pli-tv-bu-vb-np26:1.23.1: yo pana bhikkhu sāmaṃ suttaṃ viññāpetvā tantavāyehi cīvaraṃ vāyāpeyya nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyanti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np26:2.9: khomaṃ kappāsikaṃ koseyyaṃ kambalaṃ sāṇaṃ bhaṅgaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np26:2.13: nissajjitabbaṃ saṅghassa vā gaṇassa vā puggalassa vā.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np26:2.16: idaṃ me bhante cīvaraṃ sāmaṃ suttaṃ viññāpetvā tantavāyehi vāyāpitaṃ nissaggiyaṃ
